components.name: English integerized Tessdata Best model
notes: npm metadata https://registry.npmjs.org/@tesseract.js-data/eng/1.0.0 records this source gitHead and wrapper license MIT. That metadata does not establish MIT licensing of the model.
The shipped model SHA-256 is 45b4cb346724ac1774f1c36f42f182b887bcdb28ebe63e6fff90ac41f3fcff91; its Git blob SHA-1 730a6a59010b9440e38dd85f9fe6b6bf0637e6eb exactly matches the published source tree.

The original source tree has no LICENSE. Collected Apache-2.0 text was first added later, at naptha/tessdata commit 9c2fee3df42e6cdc19ebc1e4fb05a5bafa48dab0 dated 2023-08-21. Preserve this later-license provenance and the npm/repository metadata discrepancy.
The exact upstream Tessdata Best precursor revision and integerization procedure are not recorded in npm metadata and were not reconstructed here.

components.name: tr46
notes: npm metadata https://registry.npmjs.org/tr46/0.0.3 records this gitHead and MIT license; the original package/source tree has no license file.

Collected full MIT attribution was introduced later at upstream commit 3a6f29721e7063b9ffd421e461a54beae6170001 dated 2016-08-02. It is an upstream supplemental notice, not a file in the 0.0.3 release.
Generated lib/mappingTable.json is separately attributed to Unicode under unicode-idna-data.

components.name: Unicode IDNA mapping data used by tr46
notes: Reapplying the generator from tr46 source a8009f9ce80ff5dbe71dd71e203afe4e4c878d28 to the versioned official IDNA 8.0.0 table matches all 8,179 rows in the shipped node_modules/tr46/lib/mappingTable.json. Unicode 6.3, 7.0 and 9.0 do not match.
Original data notice: Copyright (c) 1991-2015 Unicode, Inc. The original data is modified by stripping comments and converting code-point ranges and replacements to a JSON numeric array.

The official current terms https://www.unicode.org/copyright.html apply Unicode License V3 to Unicode Data Files unless specific contrary terms are identified. The downloaded current license has a non-versioned official URL; its checksum pins the inspected 2026-09-30 contents.

For historical attribution, the second file preserves the official Unicode-owned ICU 56.1 license document at immutable commit 24c90c0693a0ba7aea00986c34676b55f766cfac. Its Unicode Data Files and Software section reproduces the 1991-2015 Unicode permission notice. The other ICU notices in that document are incidental; this does not claim ICU is part of tr46.
